array.string: root="$HOME/Deployments/Panels/current"; export USER="$(id -un)" LOGNAME="$(id -un)" PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" PLAN_CONFIG_PATH="$root/data/config.yaml" PLAN_DB_PATH="$root/data/planner.db" PLAN_DISPATCHER_LOCK_PATH="$root/data/dispatcher.lock" PLAN_HERMES_HOME="$HOME/.hermes" PLAN_LOGS_DIR="$root/logs" PLAN_SERVER_CONTROL_SOCKET="$root/data/server-control.sock"; exec "$root/app/bin/panels-launcher" serve
